## Orientation

Worktree: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/web-dashboard` (branch `phase/web-dashboard`, base `main`). Run every command there.

Territory: you own everything under `dashboard/web/ui/`. Do not edit `dashboard/web/*.py`, `tests/`, or `.artifacts/`. Do not call `adaptive-artifacts`.

Operational orientation:
- Rail, main pane, and side column already exist from earlier UI tasks. Add hash-route overlays for detail views.
- Detail payloads come from GET `/api/phase`, `/api/task`, `/api/requirement`, `/api/record`, `/api/needs`, `/api/backlog` (read API already serves these).
- Create `dashboard/web/ui/src/detail.test.ts` for R14–R19.
- Commit only `dashboard/web/ui/` after tests pass.

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R14: Opening a phase shows the payload of GET /api/phase, including the tabs dashboard.model.tabs_for returns for that phase.
R15: Opening a task shows the payload of GET /api/task.
R16: Opening a requirement shows the payload of GET /api/requirement.
R17: Opening a record shows the payload of GET /api/record.
R18: Opening a Needs you item shows the payload of GET /api/needs.
R19: Opening a backlog item shows the payload of GET /api/backlog.

## Approach

- Hash routes open overlays for a phase, task, requirement, record, Needs you item, and backlog item.
- Each overlay renders the payload of the matching GET route. The phase overlay includes the tabs `tabs_for` returned.
- Make the R14 through R19 cases in `dashboard/web/ui/src/detail.test.ts` pass.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R14: Opening a phase shows the payload of GET /api/phase, including the tabs dashboard.model.tabs_for returns for that phase.
R15: Opening a task shows the payload of GET /api/task.
R16: Opening a requirement shows the payload of GET /api/requirement.
R17: Opening a record shows the payload of GET /api/record.
R18: Opening a Needs you item shows the payload of GET /api/needs.
R19: Opening a backlog item shows the payload of GET /api/backlog.

### Design / decisions (quote)

Design `## Invariants`:
- Store reads go through `dashboard.model`. Store writes go through `dashboard.dismiss` and `dashboard.backlog`.
- The listen address is 127.0.0.1.
- The write API does not accept a signer.
- The API does not send `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`.

Design `## Assumptions`:
- `dashboard-package-layout` still holds: this code lives under `dashboard/`, not a new top-level app and not in `orchestra/`.
- `dashboard-deps` still holds for the terminal. The web launcher has its own PEP 723 header.
- The spike's GET shapes are the contract the Svelte app codes against.

Decisions:
- `web-dashboard-toolchain`: Vite and Svelte over the spike JSON API
- `web-dashboard-styling`: Tailwind on the spike screen map
